sourceText:
Angies Bbq Chicken Pizza
By: Angie Barrett
Published: Thursday, July 8, 2010 - 11:20am

Ingredients




1 inch pre-made pizza crust (Mama Marys 12 Thin and Crispy Crust)
3/4 cup cup to ½ Jack Daniels BBQ Sauce (depending on how much you want)
1 cup cheese (split in ½)
Tyson Precooked Grilled Chicken Strips
Baby Portabella Mushrooms

Preparation

1 Layer the ontop of the crust: 2 BBQ 3 Cup Cheese 4 Add Chicken 5 Top Chicken with remaining Cheese 6 Add mushrooms on top. 7 Bake at 425 for 7 minutes, then Drop Temp to 375 and cook for 7 more minutes or until crust is brown and chicken is heated throughout :)
